name: Clerestory window
description: High strip window: the office window's soft round-cornered frame with a single chunky mullion, sill ledge and one glass pane
mount: wall opening: origin at the bottom centre of the 2.2 x 0.7 m clerestory opening (sill 3.15, head 3.85), centred in the 0.3 m wall. Place at wallPoint(side, mid, 3.15); scale X for other widths (north bays are about 2.9-3.0 m).
notes: Glass material is 'Glass' (alpha 0.35); swap it for the game's glare glass by name.
